data.name: Ravage the Mind
data.description: As long as you are maintaining psionic focus, you gain a +%1 bonus to saves against mind-affecting effects.  If you succeed on the saving throw, you can as an immediate action cause the source of the effect to take 1 point of Wisdom damage.|RavageTheMindBonus
